title: Ruffled Sequin Ruffle Sleeve Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
Turn heads at the wedding in this dazzling dress! Featuring shimmering sequins, playful ruffle sleeves, and a flattering silhouette, this chic design is perfect for celebrating love in style. Make every moment unforgettable with this elegant yet fun wedding guest look!


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: High low.


Sleeve Style: Ruffle sleeve.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises sequin.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.
